parameters.content:
## 0) Ticket not already solved or closed

On 2026-07-23 Zendesk redelivered a `ticket created` webhook 8h37m late. The automation re-ran on the original first email, found the refundable charges already consumed, and emailed the customer a refund rejection after having already granted the refund.

Uses the base `status` string, so no `cs_project_config` column is needed and `closed` is covered for free.

Deliberately does NOT post an internal note or reopen the ticket - the shared `Do not proceed` path sets status back to `open`, which would re-queue solved tickets for agents and could re-fire the 2nd-message trigger.

Safe for legitimate follow-ups: Zendesk auto-reopens a solved ticket on requester reply, so status is `open` by then.

parameters.content:
# Second message / follow-up path

Runs on customer REPLIES inside an existing ticket, not on first contact.

**Deliberately NOT here** (first contact only, handled by `Request eligibility check with merging (first message)`):
- requester lookup + requested-tickets fetch
- the active-ticket guard and duplicate merge - the customer is by definition replying inside an active ticket, so merging could close the very ticket they are conversing in
- the AI spam check - already cleared on message one, and a terse follow-up is its worst false-positive shape

**Bug removed 2026-08-27:** the old `Evaluate Open Ticket Guard` counted ANY other requester ticket regardless of status, including solved and closed ones for 120 days. It suppressed automation for essentially every repeat customer, wrote an internal note calling closed tickets "unhandled (new)", and flipped pending tickets back to open.

**What remains:** status guard, blocklist, auto-solve list, contact-form cancellation.
